arcanas.name: Awake (IV)
arcanas.description: Gives +3 Revivals. Consuming a Revival gives +10% Max Health, +1 Armor, and +5% Might, Area, Duration, and Speed.

arcanas.name: Beginning (X)
arcanas.description: Listed weapons get +1 Amount. The character's main weapon and its evolution gain +3 Amount instead.

arcanas.name: Blood Astronomia (XXI)
arcanas.description: Listed weapons also emit special damaging zones affected by Amount and Magnet. Enemies within Magnet range take damage based on Amount.
arcanas.notes: Amount affects damage and Magnet affects area.

arcanas.name: Boogaloo of Illusions (XVIII)
arcanas.description: Overall Area continuously changes between -25% and +25% over 10 seconds. The character starts gaining +1% Area every level.
arcanas.notes: Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of Area.

arcanas.name: Chaos in the Dark Night (V)
arcanas.description: Overall projectile Speed continuously changes between -50% and +50% over 10 seconds. The character starts gaining +1% projectile Speed every level.
arcanas.notes: Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of Projectile Speed.

arcanas.name: Disco of Gold (XV)
arcanas.description: Picking up coin bags from the floor triggers Gold Fever. Obtaining gold restores as many HP.
arcanas.unlock: Reaching minute 31 in the Inlaid Library.
arcanas.notes: Big Coin Bags from Treasure Chests and level ups are also affected.

arcanas.name: Divine Bloodline (IX)
arcanas.description: Armor also affects listed weapons' damage and reflects enemy damage. Character gains bonus damage depending on missing Health. Defeating enemies with retaliatory damage gives +0.5 Max Health.

arcanas.name: Game Killer (0)
arcanas.description: Halts XP gain. Experience Gems turn into exploding projectiles. All Treasure Chests contain at least 3 items.
arcanas.unlock: Defeat the final enemy in the Cappella Magna.
arcanas.notes: Halted XP gain is ignored by Sammy via its gold-to-XP passive.

arcanas.name: Gemini (I)
arcanas.description: Listed weapons come with a counterpart.

arcanas.name: Heart of Fire (XIX)
arcanas.description: Listed weapon projectiles explode on impact. Light sources explode. Character explodes when damaged.
arcanas.notes: Explosion damage is based on the listed weapons' base damage.

arcanas.name: Iron Blue Will (VII)
arcanas.description: Listed weapon projectiles gain up to 3 bounces and might pass through enemies and walls.

arcanas.name: Jail of Crystal (XIV)
arcanas.description: Listed weapon projectiles have a chance to freeze enemies.

arcanas.name: Lost & Found Painting (XVII)
arcanas.description: Overall Duration continuously changes between -50% and +50% over 10 seconds. The character starts gaining +1% Duration every level.
arcanas.notes: Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of Duration.

arcanas.name: Mad Groove (VIII)
arcanas.description: Every 2 minutes attracts all standard stage items, pickups, and light sources towards the character.
arcanas.unlock: Reach minute 31 in the Mad Forest.

arcanas.name: Out of Bounds (XII)
arcanas.description: Freezing enemies generates explosions. Orologions are easier to find. Sorbettos could also be found.
arcanas.unlock: Reach minute 31 in the Gallo Tower.

arcanas.name: Sarabande of Healing (VI)
arcanas.description: Healing is doubled. Recovering HP damages nearby enemies for the same amount.
arcanas.notes: Healing from Reviving is also affected.

arcanas.name: Silent Old Sanctuary (XX)
arcanas.description: Gives +3 Reroll, Skip, and Banish. Gives +20% Might and -8% Cooldown for each active weapon slot left empty.
arcanas.unlock: Reach minute 31 in the Dairy Plant.

arcanas.name: Slash (XVI)
arcanas.description: Enables critical hits for listed weapons. Doubles overall critical damage.

arcanas.name: Tragic Princess (III)
arcanas.description: The cooldown of the listed weapons reduces when moving.

arcanas.name: Twilight Requiem (II)
arcanas.description: Listed weapon projectiles generate explosions when they expire. Explosions damage is affected by Curse.

arcanas.name: Waltz of Pearls (XI)
arcanas.description: Listed weapon projectiles gain up to 3 bounces.

arcanas.name: Wicked Season (XIII)
arcanas.description: Overall Growth, Luck, Greed, and Curse are doubled at fixed intervals. The character starts gaining +1% Growth, Luck, Greed, and Curse every 2 levels.
arcanas.notes: Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of Growth, Luck, Greed, and Curse

arcanas.name: Call of a Mad Moon (XIII)
arcanas.description: Effect depends on random results and player stats. Luck: improves Treasure Chests and Light Sources. Growth: improves XP Crystals. Greed: improves gold pickups. Curse: enemies gain MoveSpeed and Health.
arcanas.unlock: Reach a Luck bonus of +999% with Chula-Reh.

arcanas.name: Crystal Cries (XII)
arcanas.description: Defeating frozen enemies gives bonus MaxHealth, Recovery, and Growth. Triggers an Orologion when health reaches a critically low level.
arcanas.unlock: Trigger a Starry Heavens with She-Moon Eeta.

arcanas.name: Edge of the Earth (VIII)
arcanas.description: Gives +3 Thorns. Fixes MoveSpeed to +100%. Allows to walk through walls. Allows to vacuum Treasure Chests, Light Sources, and Weapons.
arcanas.unlock: Trigger a Lavatrix Machina with Para Kooleo.

arcanas.name: Hail from the Future (X)
arcanas.description: Receive one of the listed items when levelling up.
arcanas.unlock: Trigger a Weird Souls Purifier with Santa Ladonna.

arcanas.name: Heir of Fate (XIX)
arcanas.description: Defeating enemies with FIRE gives bonus MaxHealth and Might. Triggers an Nduja Fritta when health reaches a critically low level.
arcanas.unlock: Survive 15 minutes in Inverse Boss Rash with Random Events and Random Level Ups.

arcanas.name: Hidden Anathema (III)
arcanas.description: Food pickups grant cumulative bonuses to random stats based on their rarity or healing value.
arcanas.unlock: Eat as much as possible with Gazebo.

arcanas.name: Moonlight Bolero (VI)
arcanas.description: An extra treasure boss spawns every minute. The treasure it carries might occasionally contain arcanas and random passive weapons.

arcanas.name: Pale Diamond Incursion (V)
arcanas.description: Listed weapons aim at the nearest enemy. They gain a Cooldown bonus affected by the character's projectile Speed.
arcanas.unlock: Find 10 Golden Treasure Chests from Zi'Appunta's ability in a single run.

arcanas.name: Sapphire Mist (I)
arcanas.description: All weapons have a chance to fire twice instead of once when activated. The effect is further augmented on listed active weapons.
arcanas.unlock: Reach a Cooldown bonus of -85% with Space Dude.

arcanas.name: Stake to Your Heart (0)
arcanas.description: Halts XP gain. Enemies drop Gold Coins. Damage is dealt to Gold Coins instead of HP. A special merchant spawns every minute.
arcanas.unlock: Defeat a Bat Dragon with Big Troubler while using the Game Killer Arcana.
arcanas.notes: Halted XP gain is ignored by Sammy via its gold-to-XP passive.

arcanas.name: Victorian Horror (XVIII)
arcanas.description: Enemies within Magnet range receive Greed based damage. Once per life, triggers Cursed World Eater after receiving fatal damage.
arcanas.unlock: Survive 30 minutes with no weapons in Inverse Green Acres.

arcanas.name: Wandering the Jet Black (XXI)
arcanas.description: Losing health generates exploding projectiles. Explosion damage is increased by total recovered health and Magnet bonus. Explosion Area is increased by Magnet.
arcanas.unlock: Reach 665 Max Health with Bat Robbert.
